name: inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer1-overflow-f5-fuzz
notes: Same CPU, DMA, windows, F1 program length and bounded wait as the timer0 overflow baseline; the declaration comes from configs/behaviors/pulp_timer1_overflow_f5.json: irq_o[2] (timer1_overflow), 32 delivery ticks, trigger [[20,0],[24,0],[16,4294967295]] in the timer1 register window, status TIMER1_COUNT offset 16

the profile's own register map places timer1 at 0x10/0x14/0x18 and apb_timer.sv selects the timer instance with PADDR[4]; the entry checks each trigger and the status word against that map, so a copy of the timer0 offsets would be refused
the timer declares 50 MHz, the CPU 50 MHz and the ZipDMA a nominal 1 Hz simulation rate, so assume_single_clock states that one host tick drives all three models
two IRQ sources are declared: the target's pulse on irq_o[2] and the ZipDMA completion level; this bit is a different bit of the same 4-bit irq_o output than the baseline's bit 0
